step: Step 2: main test on ADBench (prereg_sw.md Section 6)
sw_method: thesis.spectral.spectral_weights on the members' training scores, K_train = ceil(budget * n_train); SW fusion = min-max fitted on training scores (not clipped) + weighted mean; on fallback the SW score is the EQ score

comparators.IForest: cached E1 IForest, default parameters, seed = split seed

unit: seed-mean FP@K per dataset (5 seeds), rounded to 9 decimals
procedure: fixed sequence: H-SW2 is tested only if H-SW1 is rejected

decisions.H-SW2: not tested (fixed sequence: H-SW1 not rejected)

selection_hit_rule: SW selection counts as oracle-best if its test FP@K equals the smallest member FP@K (ties: any of the tied members)
spearman_rule: per split, Spearman of v against the members' -FP@K on test (test labels, descriptive); undefined (NaN) when either is constant
note: no fraud data; Step 3 not run
